nom: Mario Badescu Super Peptide Serum with Advanced Peptide Complex

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin found this serum gave zero moisture and even made her skin drier compared to Mario Badescu's original peptide formula.
segments.oily: One reviewer speculates oily skin may tolerate this serum better than dry skin, and another with normally oil-prone concerns found the texture more oily on application but not breakout-inducing.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin expected to become an 'oil slick' but instead found her skin felt balanced, despite the serum feeling more oily and slower to dry than she was used to.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing their skin as middle-aged report a youthful glow, smoothed forehead lines, and reduced wrinkle appearance within days to weeks.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report smoothed fine lines and forehead wrinkles, a more youthful glow, and firmer or plumper-looking skin after days to weeks of use; one reviewer with long-standing wrinkles from facial expressions saw no visible or textural change even after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with dehydrated skin says it added significant hydration and softness; conversely another reviewer with dry skin says the serum provided no moisture and left her skin drier.
concerns.redness: One reviewer noted a reduction in redness alongside smaller-looking pores after several weeks of consistent use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer's skin burned on contact and again when residue reached her eyes after contact removal, suggesting irritation for sensitive or reactive skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says her large pores appeared smaller after consistent use over several weeks.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer experienced a few days of breakouts after starting a new routine that included this serum but was unsure if it was hormonal, and her skin later cleared while continuing the product; another reviewer reports no breakouts alongside more even skin tone.
concerns.oiliness: A combination-skin reviewer expected excess oiliness but instead found her skin balanced, though she noted the product itself felt more oily on application and took longer to absorb than other serums she uses.

aspects.libelle: Needs damp skin and moisturizer to work
High price relative to bottle size
Long-lasting due to small amount needed
Dropper hard to use with thick texture
Burning sensation on application or in eyes

extraits.titre: Okay, but not as great as the vitamin C serum.
extraits.texte: I use the Mario Badescu vitamin C serum and the rose hips nourishing oil for my daily routines on my face and neck. The vitamin C serum is the most superior product, in my opinion. After seeing the peptide serum with the different matte glass bottle and thick consistency, I thought I would give it a try. I don't mind consistency as long as the product works well. I don't like that the dropper doesn't work with this serum, due to the thick consistency. I don't like that the serum feels wet and slimy on my face and neck despite massaging it into my skin. After it dries, it still feels a bit sticky for a while, and I don't feel that it absorbs well into my skin or nourishes it. With that, I don't observe it making any difference or improvement to my skin appearance or texture overall or even just on a daily basis when used. With the product being as pricey as it is, I would prefer for the dropper to work and the product to noticeably improve aspects of my skin. I have wrinkles and fine lines from smiling and raising my eyebrows a lot. I haven't seen any difference, and I certainly haven't felt a difference to my skin texture. If I use the serum at night and wait a couple of hours, it is no longer sticky, and my face does feel smooth at that time. But using it in the morning hinders my routine for applying makeup within the same hour, and it doesn't leave my face feeling soft or nourished at all during the day. I now only use this serum at night before bed. It would still be dece

extraits.titre: Not like the regular peptide serum
extraits.texte: So disappointed. I use the peptide renewal serum, which is very moisturizing. In the green dropper. Very much for dry skin. This gives ZERO moisture. After three days of testing it I had to stop because it was making my skin drier. If you have oily skin it may work for you but if you were looking for a better version of the original, don't bother.

This serum I'm sure works beautifully for some, but not me. Almost immediately after putting it on, my skin started burning. I tried a handful of times, and had the same results each time. Sadly we are in the middle of quarantine so I can't return it yet.

I was very consistent in using it until the bottle finished. Around 3.5 weeks in I saw the way my face had changes. I have large pores and it def helped in making them smaller, along with the wrinkles they create and helped reduced redness.I feel like I lucked out because I bought it half off during one of the Ulta's beauty month days.
I have dehydrated skin and this has helped add so much hydration to my face!

I bought this on a whim because my skin was looking dull with my usual routine. I've been using it for a couple weeks combined with my usual moisturizer. I admit, I was skeptical. That is...until I forgot to use it one night in my routine. I can now see how much this serum helps my skin. I've avoided serums because of my combination skin. I thought I'd become an oil slick. Not so! My skin feels so balanced. It does feel more oily in application than I'm used to in products. It also takes more time to dry. But I really don't see that as a major issue considering I use it at night. I highly recommend this product if anyone is on the fence.
This serum created a youthful glow on my middle aged face after 2 days of using it. I highly recommend it!
